tools.name: mp24_getBookingUrl
tools.description: Builds a deep link to the booking wizard pre-filled with the chosen product type. Returns a URL the agent can open or hand back to the user. Supported productType values: "medycyna-pracy", "kierowcy", "sanepid", "uczniowie", "bron", "online".

options.description: Optional pre-fill: { rodzaj: "wstepne|okresowe|kontrolne", zawod: zawodId, kanal: "online|stacjonarne", kategoria: kierowcyKategoria, wariant: sanepidWariant, szkola: "standard|partnerska" }

tools.name: mp24_getContactInfo
tools.description: Returns contact details for medycynapracy24.pl (phone, e-mails per department, hours, legal entity). Use this when a user asks how to reach the clinic.

tools.name: mp24_getPartnerCities
tools.description: Returns the list of Polish cities where stationary (in-clinic) examinations are available. Use this to validate whether `city` is supported before recommending stacjonarne channel.

tools.name: mp24_getReferralGeneratorUrl
tools.description: Returns the URL of the free employer referral (skierowanie) PDF generator. The employer fills a form and downloads a Polish-compliant PDF referral that can be attached during checkout. Use this when a user mentions needing a referral document.

tools.name: mp24_getServices
tools.description: Returns the list of medical examination services offered by medycynapracy24.pl (work medicine, drivers, sanepid food handlers, students, firearms). Each entry contains id, label, starting price in PLN, available channels and the booking URL.
